mf_asi_09.oldObjective: Execute a multi-step calculation using UAM equations and perform a dimensional/sanity check.
mf_asi_09.newObjective: Execute a one-dimensional constant-acceleration calculation, identify irrelevant data, and report the result with correct units and rounding.

mf_asi_12.oldDiagramSpec: A sketch of the v-t graph and two qualitative force-arrow diagrams (one for Phase 1 showing balanced arrows, one for Phase 2 showing unbalanced arrows without prescribed direction).
mf_asi_12.newDiagramSpec: A v-t graph showing the two motion phases. Accompany it with non-directional state labels: Phase 1 — NET EXTERNAL FORCE = ZERO, Phase 2 — NET EXTERNAL FORCE = NON-ZERO. No force-direction arrows are drawn or inferred.
